verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a Structured Outputs capability that constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process the output reliably, which is the core of this story. The evidence is a single first-party summary line with no detail on schema feature coverage, strict-mode guarantees, or model support. missing for 10: details on supported JSON-schema features and limits, grammar-based constraints, per-model support, independent or hands-on corroboration of parse reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: Structured Outputs constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process generated data reliably.
